reasons.correctness: SupportTicket gets `@Version private Long version`. The changeset adds `version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL` to support_ticket, which matches the interface. Build is green, hidden tests pass 2/2, and the existing 229 tests pass.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset sits under 2026/09/ with the correct name, a -- rollback, and an include at the end with a month comment. The header reads `-- Liquibase formatted SQL`, not the specified `--liquibase formatted sql`. The new test class lacks @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class).
reasons.design_fit: The footprint is minimal: an entity field, one new changeset and one changelog include. It reuses the existing @Version pattern from PartnershipOpportunity and the add-version changesets. It adds no new mechanism and no unrelated edits.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketUnitTest only checks that a Lombok getter returns null and that the setter round-trips. It does not pin the @Version annotation or any locking behaviour, and it omits the required MockitoExtension. It is fast and has no Spring context, but asserts almost nothing.
reasons.graph_use: Before editing, graph queries located the support package files, SupportTicket dependents and TESTED_BY links. The existing @Version example was found through grep, and the changesets through glob and reads, not the graph.
